start: Owner online, Messages & offers → Workout offer, no offer running

steps.action: Fill 'Start a workout offer': 'Workouts', 'Within (days of joining)', 'Reward (extra days)', 'Members can join until', 'Check-ins that count', 'How the days are given' = 'I give them (the desk gives with one tap)'; tap 'Start offer'
user_sees: 'What members see' preview with 'OFFER'
Button reads 'Starting…'
Toast 'Offer started. Members see it in the MettleUp app now.'
must_not: Two offers started by a double tap
An offer started with a number outside the hinted range
The start form still shown while an offer runs

steps.action: When a member qualifies, tap 'Give <n> days' on their row
user_sees: Button reads 'Giving…'
Toast '<n> days added for <name>. New last day: <day>.'
must_not: The days added twice
A receipt or GST line made for the free days
Another member’s plan moved

start: Owner on a member’s page; the member shows a workout code on their phone

steps.action: Tap 'Check workout code', type the code, tap 'Check'
user_sees: Sheet 'Check workout code'
'For the workout offer. The member opens “Show my workouts to the desk” in the app. Type the code from their phone.'
A summary line, 'Code made on <day>.' and each workout day with '✓ Checked in at the desk' or 'No check-in: does not count'
must_not: A workout day without a check-in counted
Exercises, weights or body weight shown from the code
Anything saved by checking

user_sees: The extra-days sheet for this member’s plan
must_not: The button shown when no day matched
Days added without the owner confirming in the next sheet

start: Owner on the Check workout code sheet

steps.action: Leave the box empty, then type a code that is too short, has a wrong letter, or fails its check; tap 'Check'
user_sees: 'Check' is off while the box is empty
A plain problem line under the box for a bad code
must_not: A bad code shown as valid
A crash on odd letters
The old result still shown after the code is changed

steps.action: Type a code older than the limit
user_sees: 'It is more than <n> days old: ask for a new code to see the newest workouts.'
must_not: An old code treated as today’s

start: Owner opens Workout offer while the gym is not online, or the server part is missing

user_sees: 'Workout offers need your gym online' or 'Workout offers in the app are not switched on for your gym yet.'
must_not: A start form that cannot save
An endless Loading…

start: Owner, an offer is running, one member got the reward

steps.action: Tap the take-back button on that member and confirm 'Take back the <n> reward days from <name>? Their plan's last day goes back.'
user_sees: Toast 'Reward taken back. Last day: <day>.'
must_not: The last day moved back further than the reward
Take back allowed after the plan end was changed by something else, without a word

steps.action: Change 'How the days are given' to automatic
user_sees: Toast 'The days are now given by themselves.'
must_not: Days given twice to a member the desk already rewarded

steps.action: Tap the stop button and confirm 'Stop this offer? Nobody new can join. Members already in keep their days to finish.'
user_sees: Toast 'Offer stopped. Members already in can still finish.'
must_not: Members already in lose their window
New members still able to join

start: Owner checks a workout code for a member

user_sees: Only the days of workouts and whether a check-in matched
must_not: Exercises, weights, sets, body weight or photos
Another member’s days

start: Staff online, Messages & offers → Workout offer (the one part of Messages staff may open); an offer runs and a member has qualified

user_sees: Button reads 'Giving…'
Toast '<n> days added for <name>. New last day: <day>.'
must_not: Start, stop, change-mode or take-back controls shown to staff
The days added twice

steps.action: Tap 'Check workout code', type the member’s code, tap 'Check'
user_sees: The summary and the day list
'The owner gives the extra days.' in place of a button
must_not: A 'Give extra days' button for staff
Anything saved

start: Staff opens Workout offer when no offer runs; then types the address of Messages

user_sees: 'No workout offer running' with 'The owner starts one in Messages & offers.'
must_not: A start form for staff

steps.action: Type the address of another Messages part
user_sees: Staff is sent away from it (to Shop)
must_not: The owner’s message composer opened by staff

start: Staff gave a reward a minute ago; the list refreshed

steps.action: Tap give again from a second device that still shows the old list
user_sees: Toast '<name> already has the reward.'
must_not: A second set of days
A take-back button for staff
